faq.title: Main Questions from Investors in Brazil and Abroad
faq.subtitle: Answers to the main questions about real estate investment on the Santa Catarina coast

items.question: Can I buy a property in Porto Belo while living outside Brazil?
items.answer: Yes. More than 40% of my clients reside outside Brazil. The entire process can be done 100% remotely, with digital document submission, electronic signature, and legal support. Payment can be made via legalized international remittances. Many investors use this strategy to protect assets in hard currency and diversify risks.

items.question: How does direct installment payment with the developer work?
items.answer: Installment payment is one of the biggest advantages of the region. It normally works with a down payment between 20% and 30% of the property value and the balance installment directly with the developer in up to 100 or 120 months, adjusted by CUB/SC. This allows asset leverage with low monthly outlay.

items.question: Why invest in Porto Belo and not in other coastal cities?
items.answer: Porto Belo is in an initial cycle of accelerated appreciation. The city has been recording average appreciation rates between 15% and 20% per year, driven by infrastructure works, urban Masterplan, new marina, shopping mall, waterfront expansion, and strong tourism growth.

items.question: Is off-plan property really safe?
items.answer: Yes, as long as it's with solid developers and proper legal analysis. We only work with companies that have delivery history, affected assets, and validated financial schedule. Statistically, properties acquired in pre-launch have greater appreciation potential.

items.question: Can I generate income from rental even when not living in Brazil?
items.answer: Yes. Porto Belo and the region receive more than 1 million tourists per season between Porto Belo and Itapema. Short-term rental can generate annual profitability between 6% and 10%, in addition to asset appreciation.

items.question: What is the ideal profile to invest in these properties?
items.answer: Investors seeking asset protection, diversification, leverage, and above-average returns. Most buyers are entrepreneurs, liberal professionals, and investors who already understand the power of real estate as a store of value.

items.question: Is there a risk of oversupply of properties in the region?
items.answer: Not in the short and medium term. Demand is sustained by population growth, tourism, high-income migration, and geographic limitation. Porto Belo has height restrictions and territorial expansion limits, which helps maintain the balance between supply and demand.

items.question: What is the main advantage of investing with me as a consultant?
items.answer: My work is based on numbers, simulations, and strategy. I analyze the investor's profile, compare scenarios, evaluate payment flow, and focus on pre-launch opportunities, where appreciation usually happens in the first months.
